text_sanskrit: मत्कर्मकृन्मत्परमो मद्भक्तः सङ्गवर्जितः । निर्वैरः सर्वभूतेषु यः स मामेति पाण्डव ॥ ११-५५ ॥
itrans: matkarmakR^inmatparamo madbhaktaH sa~NgavarjitaH . nirvairaH sarvabhUteShu yaH sa mAmeti pANDava .. 11-55 ..
translation: He who doth duties to Me, to whom I am the Supreme Being, who is My devotee and destitute of attachment to fruits, who is no enemy to all beings, (to whom there is no enemy among all beings),- he cometh unto Me, O Pandava. (55)
